narrative: In the account book. The same leaf, the first line dry, the pen moving under it. In the account book. A short sum under the two titles, the coffer at the bed's foot, the pen lifted. In the account book. Three short lines under the sum, the last of them still wet. In the account book. The pen stops at a thud and a clatter from the kitchen below, then moves again at the foot of the leaf.
